Turn your favorite photos into keepsakes you can enjoy every day with our 2.5" x 3.5" custom photo magnets.

This larger photo magnet size gives your memories more room to shine and is perfect for family photos, weddings, babies, pets, graduations, vacations, holidays, and all of life’s special moments. Whether you’re decorating your own fridge or creating a thoughtful personalized gift, these magnets are a simple way to keep the people and memories you love close.

Each magnet is handmade using your photo and features a durable metal shell, clear protective Mylar cover, and strong magnetic backing.

Product Details

  • Measures approximately 2.5" x 3.5"
  • Personalized with your own photo
  • Available in vertical or horizontal orientation
  • Full-color printing
  • Metal shell with protective Mylar finish
  • Strong magnetic backing
  • Handmade by Magnet Moments Co.

Perfect For:
Family photos • Wedding memories • New babies • Pets • Graduation photos • Senior pictures • Vacations • Holidays • Grandparent gifts • Mother’s Day • Father’s Day • Memorial keepsakes • Stocking stuffers

products.descriptionHtml:
✨ Spotted on our feed? These are the ones everyone's talking about!

Turn your favorite photos into beautiful 2.25" round custom magnets — the perfect way to display the moments that matter most on your fridge, locker, or whiteboard. From sweet newborn snapshots to wedding portraits, vacation memories to your furry best friend, these little circles pack a whole lot of love.

⭐ Customers can't get enough

"These are absolutely gorgeous — the quality blew me away! So much better than any magnet I've seen. Already ordered them as gifts for everyone!"

🧲 Not your average magnet — here's what makes ours special:

  • 📸 Handcrafted with care — every magnet is manually pressed by hand at Magnet Moments Co.
  • 🛡️ Glossy Mylar protective cover — keeps your photos vibrant, crisp & scratch-free for years
  • 💪 Premium metal shell — durable and strong, not flimsy magnetic sheets
  • 🎁 The perfect personalized gift — for any occasion, any person
  • ✅ Strong magnetic backing — stays put on fridges, lockers & whiteboards

🎉 Perfect for:

  • Gifts — Mother's Day, Father's Day, Grandparents, or just because!
  • Milestones — Save-the-dates, birth announcements & wedding favors
  • Everyday — Upgrade your fridge with a chic, personalized aesthetic

📦 Product details:

  • Size: 2.25" Round
  • Materials: Premium metal shell, high-quality photo print, protective Mylar cover, strong magnetic backing
  • Care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth

🛒 How to order:

  1. Select your quantity below
  2. Upload your photos
  3. Add to cart and check out
  4. We'll handle the printing & shipping!

📷 Pro tip: For the best results, use clear, well-lit, high-resolution photos. We may crop slightly to fit your subject perfectly within the circular frame.

👇 Choose your quantity and make your memories stick!
